name: Nexos
oracle_text: Strategic Coordinator — Basic lands you control have "{T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only on costs that contain {X}."
blocked_sentences: Strategic Coordinator — Basic lands you control have "{T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only on costs that contain {X}."

needs.what: a mana_restriction predicate asking whether the COST BEING PAID contains {X} -- for a cast, the total cost actually paid (mana cost, or an alternative/additional cost carrying {X}); for an activation, the activated ability's own cost (e.g. "{X}, {T}: ...") -- rather than the source card's printed mana cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest is the restriction predicate x_in_mana_cost (Helga, Skittish Seer). On the cast half it reads only the spell card's printed mana cost, missing X in alternative or additional costs; on the activate half, costs.ability_purpose answers it from the SOURCE card's printed mana cost (card.mana_cost.x_count), so an X-cost ability of a permanent without {X} in its mana cost would be refused and a non-X ability of an X-cost permanent (e.g. a tap ability of Hangarback Walker) would be funded. Writing {"cast": [[{"x_in_mana_cost": true}]]} alone drops the activated-ability half; adding the activate half makes it pay for the wrong abilities. The grant itself (grant_ability static over basic lands with a grantable {T}: Add {C}{C} mana ability) is expressible; only the restriction is not.
